realms.name: Northern Realms
realms.description: Draw a card from your deck whenever you lose a round.

nilfgaard.name: Nilfgaardian Empire
nilfgaard.description: Wins any round that ends in a draw.

monsters.name: Monsters
monsters.description: Once per battle, at the end of the round, you may take one card back to your hand.

scoiatael.name: Scoia'tael
scoiatael.description: Decides who takes first turn on each round.

skellige.name: Skellige
skellige.description: At the start of round three, randomly play 2 cards from the graveyard onto the battlefield.

witcher_universe.name: Witcher Universe
witcher_universe.description: Can skip a turn once every round.

toussaint.name: Toussaint
toussaint.description: Game Start: Redraw 3 cards instead of 2. Your turn: Transform a Toussaint Monster into its next form instead of playing a card.

lyria_rivia.name: Lyria & Rivia
lyria_rivia.description: Apply a Morale Boost effect in the selected row (boost all units by 1 in this turn).

syndicate.name: Syndicate
syndicate.description: Starts the game with the Hero card Sigi Reuven on the board.

zerrikania.name: Zerrikania
zerrikania.description: Restore a unit card of your choice whenever you lose a round.

redania.name: Redania
redania.description: Can skip a turn once per game.

velen.name: Velen
velen.description: When a unit is destroyed draw a card at the turn's end. Each active Soothsayer adds +1 draw.

wild_hunt.name: Wild Hunt
wild_hunt.description: Start the game with an 11-card hand instead of 10. At the start of each round, choose a new Leader card to use its ability.

novigrad.name: Free City of Novigrad
novigrad.description: After drawing your opening hand, you may redraw 1 extra card.

ofir.name: Ofir
ofir.description: Once per game, you may search your deck for a weather card and play it.
